title: Beyond Language Modeling: An Exploration of Multimodal Pretraining
author: Shengbang Tong; David Fan; John Nguyen; Ellis Brown; Gaoyue Zhou; Shengyi Qian; Boyang Zheng; Théophane Vallaeys; Junlin Han; Rob Fergus; Naila Murray; Marjan Ghazvininejad; Mike Lewis; Nicolas Ballas; Amir Bar; Michael Rabbat; Jakob Verbeek; Luke...
summary: This work explores training a single model using both language and vision data to improve understanding and generation. The study shows that combining text with visual information helps vision tasks, while vision has little effect on language. Efficient scaling methods enable better multimodal models that naturally specialize in language or vision.
